notes.title: 🖥️ UI Improvements + Gameplay & Fullscreen Fixes
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Gamers,[/p][p]Today’s update brings visual polish and a few important fixes:[/p][p]✨ [b]UI Scale Now Affects Main Menu[/b][/p][list][*][p]The main menu will now adjust according to your [b]UI Scale[/b] setting, making it easier to see on any resolution.[/p][/*][/list][p]⚔️ [b]Fix: Player Damage Stuck[/b][/p][list][*][p]Resolved an issue where the player’s damage could get “stuck” and not update correctly.[/p][/*][/list][p]🖼️ [b]Fullscreen Behavior Improved[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fullscreen mode is now [b]relative to your screen’s resolution[/b] instead of using fixed pixels, ensuring better compatibility across different monitors.[/p][/*][/list][p]As always, thank you for your support and reports!
Your feedback helps keep The Darkblade sharper than ever.[/p]

notes.title: 💾 Save Game Import/Export + UI & Localization Fixes
notes.notes:
[p]Hi Gamers,[/p][p]We’ve just pushed a small but important update to improve your gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p]🗂️ [b]New: Import/Export Save Game[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now [b]export your save data[/b] and [b]import it again later[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Perfect for backing up progress or transferring between devices[/p][/*][/list][p]🎯 [b]Fix: Enemy Healthbar Position[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enemy healthbars are now properly aligned, especially for enemy with AOE Damage.[/p][/*][*][p]No more floating or misplaced HP bars![/p][/*][/list][p]📝 [b]Fix: Quest Detail Typo[/b][/p][list][*][p]Corrected several [b]typos in quest descriptions[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🌐 Language fixes include: [b]Indonesian[/b] and [b]Simplified Chinese[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]More updates are on the way — your feedback keeps us improving.
Let us know what you’d like to see next![/p][p]🎮 Play now & keep an eye on the shadows…[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🎥 Smoother Camera + Fullscreen
notes.notes: [p]Hey Gamers,[/p][p]Today’s update brings two key improvements that make [b]The Darkblade[/b] feel more responsive and look better on more screens:[/p][p]🚀 [b]Camera Speed Increased[/b][/p][list][*][p]Camera movement speed has been increased from [b]100 → 180[/b][/p][/*][*][p]This makes tracking smoother and snappier.[/p][/*][/list][p]🖥️ [b]Fullscreen Rendering Improved[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fullscreen mode now uses [b]the nearest monitor device pixel resolution[/b], rather than fixed pixel rendering[/p][/*][/list][p]These tweaks are all about making the game feel more fluid and visually consistent across setups — small changes with a big impact.[/p][p]As always, thanks for playing and helping us improve [i]The Darkblade[/i]![/p][p]Don’t forget to [b]wishlist the game on Steam[/b] and share your feedback![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🐞 Bug Fixes – The Darkblade Patch 2025-07-25
notes.notes: [p]Hey Gamers,[/p][p]Today’s patch focuses on fixing a major crash and improving one of the upgrade UX issues:[/p][p]🛠️ [b]Bug Fix: Force Close with Indonesian Language[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a crash that occurred when playing with [b]Bahasa Indonesia[/b] selected[/p][/*][*][p]The game should now run [b]smoothly[/b] in Indonesian — no more sudden force closes during gameplay or menus[/p][/*][*][p]Terima kasih for your patience![/p][/*][/list][p]✨ [b]Upgrade Menu Closing Enhancement[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved the behavior when [b]closing the Core Upgrade UI/Enhancement[/b][/p][/*][*][p]No more awkward transitions or UI glitches after upgrading — it now feels smoother and more responsive[/p][/*][/list][p]Im continuing to polish the game and squash bugs — thanks to everyone reporting issues and helping me make [i]The Darkblade[/i] a better experience.[/p]

notes.title: 🎮 Controller Update – D-Pad Movement Support + Menu Fix
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Gamers,[/p][p]We’ve got a small but meaningful update for all the controller players out there![/p][p]✅ [b]New: D-Pad Support for Movement[/b]
You can now use the [b]D-Pad[/b] to move your character — not just the analog stick![/p][list][*][p]Ideal for precision movement in tight spaces[/p][/*][*][p]Great for those who prefer classic directional input[/p][/*][/list][p]🛠️ [b]Bug Fix: Load Game Dialog Not Closing[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]Load Game dialog[/b] wouldn’t close after selecting a save file from the main menu (when using controller)[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again to everyone who reported these issues and shared suggestions — your feedback directly improves [i]The Darkblade[/i] every step of the way.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🖥️ Update – Fullscreen Now Works with Any Resolution
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Gamers,[/p][p]We’ve rolled out a small but important update to improve fullscreen support:[/p][p]✅ [b]Fullscreen Now Works with Any Resolution[/b]
You can now switch to fullscreen using [b]any resolution[/b] available in the settings — no restrictions.[/p][p]❗[b]Note:[/b] If your selected resolution doesn’t match your monitor’s aspect ratio, the game will display with [b]black bars[/b] to maintain proper scaling and avoid distortion. This ensures the pixel art and gameplay look crisp and consistent across all setups.[/p][p]Thanks as always for your feedback — keep it coming! And if you haven’t already, [b]wishlist The Darkblade[/b] on Steam and help spread the word![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: ⭐ Dungeon Rank Adjustments
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Gamers,[/p][p]We’ve got another update based on community feedback — this time from a dedicated player, [b]Judgement Kazzy[/b], who pointed out something important:[/p][quote][p][i]“In Hardcore Mode, getting 3 stars in dungeons feels basically impossible.”[/i][/p][/quote][p]And they were right.[/p][p]🛠️ [b]Dungeon Ranking System Updated[/b][/p][p]We’ve adjusted the [b]time thresholds[/b] for earning 1-star, 2-star, and 3-star dungeon clears, especially in [b]Hardcore Mode[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]3-star ranks are now more achievable[/p][/*][*][p]2-star ranks are more balanced for mid-level players[/p][/*][*][p]1-star ranks give more breathing room for exploration[/p][/*][/list][p]🎯 [b]Perfect Dungeon Conquer Quest Requirement Updated[/b]
You now only need [b]2 stars[/b] to [b]trigger Perfect Dungeon Conquer Quests[/b].
No need to hit a flawless 3-star run just to unlock them — but it’s still there for bragging rights.[/p][p]🗡️ [b]Increased Weapon Drop Rate[/b]
We’ve increased the [b]weapon drop rate[/b] in [b]Dungeon Boss Chests[/b].
Now you’ll have a better chance to get new gear after those intense battles.[/p][p]This update should make dungeon progression [b]more rewarding and less punishing[/b], especially for players who enjoy both challenge and loot.[/p][p]💬 Huge thanks to [b]Judgement Kazzy[/b] for the valuable insight!
Keep the feedback coming — you're helping shape [i]The Darkblade[/i] into something truly great.[/p]

notes.title: 🩸 Major Update – Health Points Added in Casual Mode!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Gamers,[/p][p]We’ve been listening closely to your feedback — and one thing came through loud and clear:[/p][quote][p][i]“Casual Mode is still brutally hard.”[/i][/p][/quote][p]📊 Based on feedback from over 80% of players, we’re making a [b]major update[/b] to improve the experience:[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]✅ [b]Health Points Added to Casual Mode[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622115/14ec8e53e39135556f1f8ebaf0c545094105f8f3.png"][/img][/p][p]Casual Mode now features its own [b]HP system[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]You can take multiple hits without dying instantly[/p][/*][*][p]Makes the game more forgiving and exploration-friendly[/p][/*][*][p]Great for players who want to focus on the story and atmosphere[/p][/*][/list][quote][p]❗Note: Now [b]you will NOT receive any defense % buffs[/b].[/p][/quote][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🖥️ [b]New: UI Scale Settings[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622115/ab39fef9db86e58dcb35ab4be6a04dd4b137e25e.png"][/img][/p][p]You can now adjust the [b]UI size[/b] from the settings menu![/p][list][*][p]Useful for different screen sizes or personal preference[/p][/*][*][p]Especially helpful on large displays[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]💬 Keep the Feedback Coming!
This game is built with your input. We're committed to making The Darkblade challenging but fair — and fun for everyone.[/p][p]If you haven’t already, [b]wishlist the game on Steam[/b] and help spread the word![/p]

notes.title: Fix - Automatically Opening Discord
notes.notes: [p]Hi Gamers,[/p][p]Quick hotfix! Some players noticed that [b]if you had Discord installed but not running[/b], the game would try to auto-launch it and the game not running at all. That was [b]not intended[/b] — and it's now [b]fixed[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]✅ [b]What’s Fixed:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The game no longer forces Discord to open[/p][/*][*][p]If Discord isn’t running, it simply skips Discord integration and runs normally[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks to those who reported it![/p][p]Keep the feedback coming, and don’t forget to [b]wishlist The Darkblade[/b] if you haven’t already.[/p]

notes.title: Controller Support
notes.notes:
Hey Gamers,

We’ve updated The Darkblade with some exciting new features!

🎮 Full Controller Support
The Darkblade now fully supports gamepads! Especially Xbox Controller, you can now slash, roll, and dodge enemies comfortably from your couch.

🧭 Demo Content Update
The demo just got a little change:

- The whole content update into mid-game(ish)
- Updated dialogue scenes

Hidden lore for those who seek it
(Yes, you lore skippers still get the summary and skip button 😉)

💬 Let Us Know What You Think
Your feedback has been incredible so far. Keep it coming 🔥.

Thanks for playing and supporting The Darkblade. If you haven’t already, wishlist the full game on Steam to follow L's journey.
